name: FSL Brain Extraction (BET) on DWI
summary: Removes non-brain tissue from DWI with FSL BET, estimating the mask on the mean b0 image, and outputs the masked DWI and a brain mask.
description: Extracts the b=0 volumes with select_dwi_vols, averages them, runs FSL bet on the mean b0 (optionally with -R) and multiplies every DWI volume by the resulting mask. Use it when a skull-stripped DWI or a diffusion-space brain mask is needed. bvals and bvecs are copied unchanged. The input must contain b=0 volumes.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
inputs.requirements: Must contain b=0 volumes; the mask is estimated from their mean.

outputs.description: The brainmask for the DWI image

parameters.description: choose the fractional intensity threshold (0 -> 1); default=0.4; smaller values give larger brain outline estimates
choose the vertical gradient in fractional intensity threshold (-1->1); default=0; positive values give larger brain outline at bottom, smaller at top
if robust is set as true, will iteratively run bet2 to get better brain outlines

failure_modes.fix: Check the log for bet errors and that the DWI has b=0 volumes.
